source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: In recurrent-depth processing, what is repeatedly transformed before an output token is selected?

options.feedback: The recurrent block refines hidden vectors. Those passes can occur without adding words to a visible reasoning trace.

options.text: A newly printed sentence in the response.
options.feedback: Printing additional text grows the output sequence. Hidden recurrence works on representations before output selection.

options.text: An updated set of training labels.
options.feedback: Training labels concern learning from examples. Recurrent-depth inference applies an already trained block to a representation.
Reusing a computation block does not require expanding the vocabulary. It increases processing of the internal state.
